featured_reviews.name: vijay wadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Biryani Barbeque Chinese restaurant is a multi cuisine restaurant in Borivali West.
One of the oldest restaurants.
It offers vegetarian and non vegetarian food.
It has good options for non vegetarian Biryani, Chicken tikka, mutton Sikh kabab, tandoori chicken.
It has a good variety of Chinese dishes.
Food quality is good and all the dishes are tasty.
This restaurant has ample seating arrangements on the ground floor and first floor. The ambience is ok.
Service is fast enough.
Generally it is a bit crowded during weekends, but the waiting period is manageable as it has more sitting arrangements on the first floor.
It has valet parking so parking is not an issue.
This restaurant also serves alcohol.
Offers a variety of Indian and imported whisky, Vodka, rum, Gin and liquor. Also has a good choice of beers.
The food prices are ok, but alcohol is on a bit higher side.
Overall it is worth visiting with family and value for money.

featured_reviews.name: Hitesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a satisfying experience at Restro Bar - Biryani Barbeque. The place offers a comfortable dining environment and is well-suited for a relaxed meal with friends or family.

What stands out is that it is one of the few places in Borivali West that serves good quality non-vegetarian food. Given that the area has a significant Gujarati community and is largely dominated by vegetarian options, this restaurant provides a refreshing and much-needed alternative for non-vegetarian diners.

The food was well-prepared, flavourful, and lived up to expectations. The biryani and barbeque items were particularly enjoyable, with balanced spices and good portion sizes. The service was prompt and courteous, contributing positively to the overall experience.

Overall, it is a dependable choice for those looking for good non-vegetarian options in Borivali West, and I would certainly recommend it for a satisfying meal.

featured_reviews.review_text: Last night, we visited a restaurant with an inviting and cozy atmosphere that immediately set the tone for a great evening. The ambiance was warm and welcoming, with tasteful decor that made the space feel both elegant and relaxed. The service was attentive and friendly, with staff who genuinely seemed to care about our experience, making us feel well looked after from start to finish. The food was excellent, showcasing fresh ingredients and carefully balanced flavors, and each dish was presented beautifully. Overall, it was a fantastic dining experience that combined quality, comfort, and an elevated sense of hospitality.

Any BBC u visit is thd best in all senses, my always go to place and have a great time with family. I had serving of Mutton Biryani, a celebrated and aromatic rice dish that originated on the Indian subcontinent. The vibrant yellow and orange hues of the rice come from saffron or food coloring, while the garnish of crispy fried onions adds a distinct texture and flavor. Often considered a complete meal, a staple of Hyderabadi cuisine and is typically served alongside a side of raita or salad also we ordered some chicken Chilli as for the starters.

The staff here us very friendly, reservations available and the ambience is cozy loved it will visit soon.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Borivali Biryani Centre is a go-to spot for biryani lovers who crave rich flavors and hearty portions. This casual eatery has a straightforward, no-frills vibe — all attention is on delivering satisfying, flavorful meals.

The biryanis here are aromatic, perfectly spiced, and generously portioned, making them a hit with both regulars and first-time visitors. Beyond biryani, the menu also includes other popular North Indian dishes that complement the main attraction.

Service is friendly and efficient, and the place is ideal for a quick lunch, dinner, or takeaway. Borivali Biryani Centre is the kind of spot where you know you’ll get consistent, comforting flavors every time — perfect for a satisfying, casual meal.

featured_reviews.review_text: We went there in a group of four people and it was suggested by my friend as a popular eat out and the restaurant is the oldest or the main branch. We ordered Paya soup & Tulsi tomato soup for starters and both were amazing. The soups were right in taste, not too mild not too spicy. For appetizers we ordered hara bhara kebab & mutton seekh kebab, again, both were amazing. In the main course we went ahead with Veg & Chicken Dum Biryani, the biryanis were okay. As we were three people eating chicken biryani, we ordered full chicken biryani which was sufficient if you want to eat right else you go for a large size which would serve 4 people. Lastly we had custard pudding and blue mist as desserts and coolers. The pudding was very good. Overall, a very good place to visit for food, I can go again for Paya soup, mutton seekh kebab and custard pudding.

featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a restaurant 🏨 chain ⛓️ in Mumbai, known for its Mughlai 🍢 and non-veg food. I won't recommend this place much if you are Jain 👳or pure vegetarian 🥬. It's a 2 florey restaurant with AC 🌬️ and Non-AC 🪭 section usually the restaurant is packed during weekend. The name of the restaurant is BBC (Borivali Biryani 🍚 Center) known for its Biryani and majorly non-veg. If talking about the staff 🧑‍💼 they were occupied a lot and a bit ignorant about the customer 🙂, I asked 3-4 times for the same thing to different people still could not get much respond. The ambience ✨ of of Family restaurant and cleanliness 🧹 is maintained. Washroom is unisex and 🫧 clean however there was water blocked at some place.

Further, talking about the foods and the drinks that we tried :

1. Blue bliss - it's basically a lemonade 🍋 with an added food colour 🔵, it was sweet but an good option from the mocktail menu.

2. Virgin mojito 🍸- Just an old school taste of soda 🥤mixed with lemon 🧃 juice and with some basil 🌿 leafs in it.

3. Lemon Iced Tea ☕- It's a cool starter in drinks 🍷 to go with along with some heavy food.

3. Veg dum biryani 🌾- It's a simple option if you don't want to explore kuch and it's a safer option. I asked them to make it a bit spicy 🔥. A taste of mixed vegetables 🍆 and paneer served with boondi raita.

4. Paneer Crispy Plum  - It's a chinese sweet🍯 starter with some added veggies. I usually don't prefer sweets so I won't recommend the same.

5. Mushroom  🍄 Tikka - It's just like paneer tikka 🍢 but instead paneer mushroom 🍄 is used. For a change you can try mushrooms instead of Paneer.

The overall experience was okay as the staff was not attentive, the food taste in veg was not that good and I didn't have much to explore on the menu. You can go here for mughlai and kebabs dish 🍽️.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Potlibaba’s Kitchen is a wonderful place for authentic and delicious food. The taste, quality and service were all really impressive. We tried the Chicken Cheese Fingers, Vade, Malvani Chicken Thali, Mutton Thali and Fish Thali and everything was absolutely 😍

The Chicken Cheese Fingers were crispy and cheesy, the Vade were fresh and perfectly made and all the thalis were full of rich authentic flavors. The Malvani Chicken Thali was especially delicious with its spicy and traditional taste. The Mutton Thali was flavorful and satisfying and the Fish Thali was fresh and very tasty.

A great place for anyone who loves Malvani food. Highly recommended for a fulfilling and tasty meal.❤️😍

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Kalyan Revankar
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited this place atleast 2-3 times in the last 2-3 months with family and friends. Trust me, it truly made me feel like that I am having homemade sea food. There ambience has been good.I tried relishing their pomfret, king mackerel and bombil thali, it's all amazing. Quantity they serve is really good. Staff is very polite and they helps you with an option about what to choose from their speciality.. though I didn't try their chicken dishes yet, but they serve amazing bombil potli, prawns potli,mandeli potli and mutton potli. Prices wise also it is very friendly. Over all I had a very good experience visiting this place. Going there early in the evening at around 7:30-8pm is preferrable even on the weekends when all the sea food lovers try and cash on too. Because the place is very tiny. As there are hardly 8-10 tables but they have a huge kitchen. Majority of the sea food lovers prefer ordering food from Zomato or Swiggy . Staff really makes you feel comfortable at all times. If you are a true sea food lover and staying near by in borivli and dahisar then this one is a must visit place. It's located in the heart of IC colony at holy cross road and at 5 minutes walking distance from mandapeshwar/IC colony metro station, near Studio Fernandes,St Thomas Church Road.

featured_reviews.name: Ameya Banavali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst experience on Diwali day!!
Pity the owners because the server threatened customers that they will hit them and the owners would not say anything

Detailed review
I visited today at 1:50 pm. There were people in waiting outside.
After waiting for 6 minutes, a server came out to inform that there was a notebook kept at the side which the customer had to note down their booking by themselves for (no staff to do this)

After waiting for half an hour in the sweltering heat, we (myself, wife and father in law ) got a seat at the further most corner. The one and only AC in the place was running at full throttle but it failed to provide cooling to the crowded room full of customers.

We had already chosen our choice of orders during our wait outside.

Order for :
- Mutton Thali
- Extra Chapati
- Extra Bhakri
- Bombil Fry
- Chicken Poppers
- Alani Bhaat
- Thumbs up half ltr.

After waiting for another 10 mins seated on the table, the server (same guy as earlier) came and took our order very efficiently. 👍

This was at around 2:30 pm. As it was too late for lunch already, we instructed the waiter to get our orders as soon as they were prepared.

The server promptly got the coldrink and plonked the bottle on the table without serving and left. Then we waited and waited and waited.... And waited some more....
In-between we asked the waiter 5 times about when we could see some food on our table his reply everytime was " bas aa rahaa hai"

So after waiting till 3 pm after my senior citizen father in law started getting agitated, (by this time the bombil had been served to us by a lady). At this point I asked the waiter in a loud voice about rest  of my order, The moment I raised my voice, the waiter started shouting back and threatened to hit me.

When the matter escalated, another guy, seemingly the owner came to our table to sort out the matter , he confessed theybwere short on staff  today (not my problem but still)

The lady also intervened and then on she cooled the situation with prompt service and the required attention.

On the food front
Bombil were oily
Mutton was chewy
Poppers were good
Alani Bhaat was excellent

Trigger points-
- This hotel doesnt even have a working washbasin for customers to rinse post meal. Please bear in mind that these people serve fish.
- The AC is pathetic which brings upon a strange discomfort while eating.
- An uncle is a safari suit who was from the restaurant team and claimed be from some food department told that everything is made fresh.  This explains the chewy undercooked mutton as you need to cook mutton for atleast an hour, and simmer before dishing it out.
-Total bill was 1780.

Post meal review-
- At the time of writing this detailed review I am feeling acidic reflux and so is my wife which indicates the quality of ingredients used.

Dear owners
- Your food is pathetic.
- Your ambience is meh.
- Not to be classist but your service is good probably for the slums, not IC Colony.

P.S. I have also messaged my friend who recommended your restaurant to stay away henceforth.

Happy Diwali!

Borivali Biryani Center offers a good dining experience, especially for biryani lovers. The biryani taste was quite good, and it’s nice that they serve both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.

featured_reviews.name: Ravi Rana
featured_reviews.review_text:
I felt very disappointed when I went to the BBC restaurant in Chikoo Wadi on 27th december 2025  to celebrate with my entire family. We ordered biryani and found a hair in it. I felt very bad because this was the third time this has happened.
The first time, they served stale biryani. The second time, there was hair in the food, but I did not take any photo or video and decided we would not come again. However, this time again, there was hair in the biryani, so I took photos and videos.
What shocked me the most was that the manager still asked for the full bill and did not even replace the order. And they even added the cost of a cold drink that we had brought from home without asking us. You can see it clearly on the bill—it has been written with a pen....From today onwards, I have decided never to come here again. My family and people from my society will also not visit BBC anymore. I am not provoking anyone; I am just saying that if you go there, please be careful about hygiene.
If that hair had gone into someone’s lungs, what could have happened? The hotel staff does not seem to care. What was even more surprising was that when I informed the hotel seniors (higher authority) about the issue, they themselves said, “You must have put the hair in the food. If you have a problem, don’t come to the hotel.”
Big surprise reply gt....Sorry to say, we will not visit again...👎👎👎

Tried out Borivali Biryani Centre recently and honestly – if you’re a biryani lover, this place should be on your list!

To sip on, we ordered a mojito, which was alright – refreshing but nothing extraordinary.

Now here’s the thing – the biryanis here steal the show. If you’re visiting, go for the biryanis. That’s where they truly shine. Other stuff’s okay, but nothing comes close to their signature biryani.

A heads-up though: the place gets really crowded. There’s usually a long queue outside, so if you’re planning a visit, try to go early or see if you can reserve a table. We had to call the staff multiple times just to place an order, and while they were polite, they seemed short-staffed for the kind of crowd they handle.

On the plus side, the ambiance is nice and fresh, and the restaurant has a clean, cozy vibe.

Final verdict:

Come for the biryani. Be patient with the service. Totally worth it if you’re craving something flavorful and filling. Would recommend, just plan your timing!

Banjara Restaurant in Borivali is one of the most popular family dining spots in the area — known for its delicious food, pleasant ambience, and courteous service. It perfectly balances taste, presentation, and hospitality, making it an excellent choice for both casual meals and family gatherings.

The food quality is top-notch. The North Indian and Mughlai dishes are especially outstanding — rich in flavor, perfectly spiced, and cooked with fresh ingredients. Their Butter Chicken, Paneer Tikka Masala, and Mutton Rogan Josh are crowd favorites. The Banjara Special Biryani deserves a special mention — aromatic, well-cooked rice with tender pieces and balanced masala.

They also serve good Chinese and Continental options. The Manchow Soup, Hakka Noodles, and Crispy Veg are quite popular among regulars.

The ambience is elegant and comfortable — dim lighting, spacious seating, and a relaxed family-friendly vibe. It’s clean, well-maintained, and gives a premium dining feel without being overly expensive.

Service is excellent. The staff is professional, well-trained, and attentive. Food arrives on time even during weekends when the restaurant is crowded.

Value for money: Slightly on the higher side compared to regular eateries, but completely worth it for the quality, taste, and overall experience.

What I liked:
✅ Excellent quality food with authentic flavors
✅ Elegant and comfortable ambience
✅ Courteous and efficient staff
✅ Wide variety of dishes for both veg and non-veg lovers

What can improve:

Parking space is limited during weekends

Slight waiting time during peak hours (reservation recommended)

Overall:
Banjara Restaurant in Borivali is a perfect blend of taste, comfort, and quality. Whether you’re dining with family, celebrating a special occasion, or simply craving rich Indian food, this place never disappoints. Highly recommended for food lovers who value both flavor and atmosphere.

featured_reviews.name: Ajay Deshmukh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited The Bliss Cuisine and Libation on 26th May 2026 to celebrate my parents' anniversary, expecting a pleasant fine-dining experience. Unfortunately, it turned out to be one of the most disappointing restaurant visits I've had.

We ordered Soup, Prawns Tempura Sushi (4 pcs), and Chicken Chilly. The soup was decent, but the problems started when the sushi arrived. The portion size was surprisingly small compared to what is typically served at good restaurants. While I was willing to overlook that, the bigger issue was the filling. There was hardly any prawn in the sushi—most of what we got was the fried coating. To make matters worse, the dish contained minced prawn instead of actual prawn pieces, which was not what we expected.

When I politely raised this concern with the waiter, his response was rude and dismissive. He simply said, "This is how we make it here," in a tone that was far from customer-friendly. This is not how paying customers should be spoken to, especially in a restaurant that positions itself as a fine-dining establishment.

I requested to speak with the manager. While the manager listened to the issue, no effort was made to resolve it. I asked them to take the dish back and remove it from the bill, but they refused. I even offered to pay half the price of the dish as a compromise, but there was no flexibility. I then requested them to cancel our pending order and bring the bill.

What made the experience worse was that despite repeated apologies from Manager , there was no acknowledgment from the waiter regarding his behavior. The lack of accountability and basic courtesy completely spoiled what was supposed to be a special family occasion.

We paid the bill and left feeling disrespected rather than valued as customers.

If you're looking for good hospitality and customer service, I would recommend looking elsewhere. The food may be average, but poor service and disrespectful behavior are far harder to overlook.

I hope the owner takes customer feedback seriously and trains the staff on how to interact professionally with patrons. Experiences like this can drive customers away and damage the restaurant's reputation.

featured_reviews.review_text: The Biryani Life is part of the conglomerate called EatSure and is one of two biryani options available on the app in IC colony, the other being Behrouz biryani. The Biryani offered here is similar to Behrouz but just cheaper, and does not come with all the bells and whistles like Gulab jamun and in a pretty box like Behrouz does. Just simple biryani in a plastic box along with raita. The cost is slightly on the expensive side as compared to local biryani outlets in the colony but the taste is pretty decent. The hyderabadi variation is spicy whereas the Lucknowi one is just about right. I have tried both the chicken and paneer options and would definitely recommend if there is a discount on the EatSure app.

featured_reviews.name: Asus Kandivali
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently ordered food through Swiggy and had a very disappointing experience. The food was delivered in a recyclable trash container that looked unhygienic and completely unfit for serving fresh food. It honestly felt like the packaging was made from reused or extremely low-quality material.

For the price I paid, I expected proper, safe, and food-grade packaging. This was unacceptable, and it really affected my trust in the restaurant as well as the delivery platform.

I hope Swiggy takes strict action and ensures that restaurants use clean, standard packaging. No customer should receive food in such poor-quality containers.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I went for Sunday dinner with my friend. They also have facility to sit at roof top. This place has got good ambience.
For starter we ordered house spiced chicken. The sauce was good but chicken was average. We also ordered Mojito and cranberry cooler. They have got wide range of alcohol but as we wanted to drive post dinner, couldn't have it.
For main course we ordered chicken Lajawab and cheese garlic naan. It was good. Overall experience is nice, more due to ambience and Service. Waiters are humble and served us well.

featured_reviews.name: M m
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located at the start of Eksar ..this was a pleasant surprise. They serve vegetarian as well as non vegetarian fare. We couldnt go beyond the starters. The portions are good. Three could share one. You can find a variety of south style fish chicken n mutton.For the gravy do try their Saoji chicken. For starters we went for
Chermoula chicken- boneless chicken marinated in green masala. It was a filler
chicken tunday kebab- Juicy minced chicken kebab in assorted indian spices. Totally yummy and not spicy.
Malabari jhinga(prawns) coconut.The chunks ot prawns were good and the coconut masala was yummy.
chicken chapli kebab- Another favourite.
The ambience is good and quiet. Soft music is played in the bavkhround.You can visit with your family.There is also a rooftop terrance area. The staff is polite n courteous.Service was prompt.Reasonably Priced.Three could have a meal within 2k.

They have terrace dining available, which could be a nice option for people who like quiet places for dinner.

featured_reviews.name: Sheetal S
featured_reviews.review_text:
Well at first when we entered we were surprised to see that there was no one seated and we were the only group to enter. The person who allocated the table looked quite cold and least interested. We gave first order of nachos and it was served in a very sad way. No where compared to place like fusion kitchen, farm house and other restaurants in Borivali. The nachos were well made but the cheese was given separately along with two other dips. It was such a small quantity that was not at all expected. Then we asked for extra dip and they gave us. So that was a good part. Later on we started ordering more food and all of sudden the person who serving us started showing interest in serving our group and asked the review of the food. The sizzlers were really well made. Infact apart from nachos other items were well served with proper quantity. They have list of desserts but only limited are offered.
Giving 4 stars as they need little more training and may be show a bit more interest towards the customer since it's a service industry. I would recommend the place especially for sizzlers.

featured_reviews.review_text: A welcoming place with good taste of music being played ( English) and also the food is good 👍🏽. You have parking just opposite the restuarant. A quiet area arround to chill in the late evening.
